ordinary_input_note: input_id is the original public input identifier; input_sha256 hashes the actual solver input after the existing syntax adapter.
scope: Native replay uses Z3 proof checking. External results require original-input binding, independent polynomial replay, and Carcara/Pacheck completion. Lean is not included. Historical PR2 377/390 used a different reconstruction pipeline and is not interchangeable with native replay.
methodology: Native and external comparisons are separate runs. Ordinary baseline/candidate runs were paired in randomized order. External timing includes interpreter startup and process teardown; failed checker process trees, including detached groups, are stopped before the next wave. Output archives are created and hash-verified only between timed waves. Superseded external runs with incomplete child cleanup are excluded.
model_audit_method: model_validate=true, 12 seconds per input, with the completed answer sequence required to match the paired run.
